Describe the program or record change and link its public evidence.

- [ ] Amounts use integer base units; program and shared pool caps are respected.
- [ ] Claim identity, team eligibility and related-party disclosures were reviewed.
- [ ] Binding author, signature, account and chain evidence were checked where relevant.
- [ ] New or changed links observe seven days; ids and historical records are retained.
- [ ] No unpublished security information or real secrets appear in this change.
- [ ] Validator and offline tests pass.

For payments, link the approved entry and verify every recipient, amount and memo.
